method: Synthetic runtime comparison before the anchored-ornament repair. Current app and baseline app were served on local ports 8784 and 8785. Baseline server overrides only app.js and app.css with commit 9ab1910. Named Ann, medium and long40 cases use locally supplied official fonts and 125% text; suite and signed-out cases use the harness fallback fonts. No UI layout DOM edits. The suite fixture defaults to signed-in Sam.
limits: Temporary probe sampled the two-frame handoff for four ornament families at 390 px. Motion rectangles vary slightly with sampling. Only recorded geometry supports this comparison; it is not a broad seasonal audit.
